articles.title: NetBSD 11.1 released
articles.summary: The first point release for NetBSD 11 has been released. As the version number suggests, there’s no major changes here. This release includes security updates for mozilla-rootcerts, brotli, xorg-server, hdaudio(4), compat_linux(8), unbound(8), and ipfilter.

articles.title: Deadly Days: Roadtrip 1.0 review
articles.summary: Now Deadly Days: Roadtrip has left Early Access as a full and complete game, here's my thoughts on this zombie-slaying bullet heaven inventory management game.

articles.title: ChatGPT can now turn text prompts and photos into animated GIFs with OpenAI's Images 2.6 model
articles.summary: OpenAI is adding a GIF feature to ChatGPT. With the new Images 2.6 model, users can create animated GIFs from text prompts or photos and then adjust speed and individual frames.

articles.title: datasette-llm 0.1a10
articles.summary: Release: datasette-llm 0.1a10 Fixes a bug that affected my agent.datasette.io demo site, where the set of available LLM models was not correctly restricted to just those in the configuration.

articles.title: AM2r Wii Port
articles.summary: Developer cmyksoda has just released a port of Another Metroid 2 Remake to the Wii, built on the Butterscotch GameMaker runner with a native GX renderer.

articles.title: PiPedal Grants Guitar Effects, Amp Emulation, and More
articles.summary: Back in the day, if one wanted a particular guitar effect one would purchase an effects pedal or “stomp box”, and even a modest collection of them could be an eye-watering investment.

articles.title: Livestream: Watch Labrinth create a song from scratch tonight using Apple’s new MacBook Pro
articles.summary: To promote the new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display , Apple is hosting a livestream in which singer-songwriter Labrinth will create a song from scratch overnight at the company’s Tower Theatre store in Downtown Los Angeles.

articles.title: Mid-week Android app deals and freebies: Poker Ya Joker, Despotism, Potion Permit, more
articles.summary: Today’s best Google Play app and game deals are ready, including This Aint Even Poker, Ya Joker, Potion Permit, Slime Legends – Survivor, Despotism 3k, Three Kingdoms: Grand Strategy, Can You Escape: The Collection, My Car My Life, and more.

articles.title: Open source AI is booming. Hugging Face explains who profits.
articles.summary: On this episode of TechCrunch’s Equity podcast, Rebecca Bellan caught up with Irene Solaiman , Chief Policy Officer and SVP of Strategy at Hugging Face, about what startups need to know before building on open models, from choosing the right tools and infrastructure to navigating the trade-offs shaping the future of open AI.

articles.title: Dolphin Depot: GameCube “Homebrew Channel”
articles.summary: Developer Webhdx has just launched “Dolphin Depot”, which is essentially an app store / homebrew channel for the GameCube. Your GC would require internet access, but luckily there’s now affordable homebrew NIC’s available .

articles.title: 9to5Mac Daily: November 4, 2026 – iOS 27.3 beta 1 now available
articles.summary: Listen to a recap of the top stories of the day from 9to5Mac . 9to5Mac Daily is available on iTunes and Apple’s Podcasts app , Stitcher , TuneIn , Google Play , or through our dedicated RSS feed for Overcast and other podcast players.

articles.title: ‘Enough Phone’ is an Android phone roughly the size of iPhone 13 Mini, launching in 2027
articles.summary: “Enough Phone” measures in at 132.8 x 63.8 x 12mm and will have a battery between 3,500 and 4,000 mAh which will be user-replaceable. While it’s thicker, the physical size is roughly the same as iPhone 13 Mini.

articles.title: GKE Workspaces: Your notebook, on Google's AI infrastructure
articles.summary: Today we're introducing GKE Workspaces , a self-hosted AI/ML development platform for Google Kubernetes Engine, built on the open source Kubeflow Workspaces project. Deployed on your team's GKE cluster, it provides a dedicated web dashboard where you can pick an IDE and a machine, and start coding on cloud accelerators in minutes.

articles.title: Megaquarium dev reveals Plantlife, a botanical farming management sim
articles.summary: Megaquarium developer Twice Circled just revealed Plantlife, a really sweet looking botanical farming management building sim. Taking what they learned building Megaquarium and going in a rather different direction.

articles.title: Anthropic's text watermark is easy to bypass on several older Claude models
articles.summary: Anthropic is rolling out text watermarks to four more Claude models ahead of the EU AI Act's December deadline. But on older models like Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6, API users can disable the watermark by changing a single sampling parameter.

articles.title: datasette-agent 0.5a0
articles.summary: Release: datasette-agent 0.5a0 This is a significant release of Datasette Agent . The most notable new feature is called the panel - it lets the agent chat open and then sit next to pages from Datasette, for example a table or query page.

articles.title: Ocarina of Time 2026: DF Retro Review
articles.summary: John Linneman from Digital Foundry has just released a review and tech analysis of the Switch 2’s remake of Ocarina Of Time. John compares it to the 1998 original, as well as the 3DS remake from 2011.

articles.title: The first Snapdragon phone with Android Linux Terminal support is here
articles.summary: Android power users who want a new Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6-powered phone like the Redmagic 12 Pro now have another reason to be excited about the latest Qualcomm processors: the Android Linux Terminal.

articles.title: UPSHOT brings some online co-op ball-shooting comedy on November 12
articles.summary: The developer emailed GamingOnLinux to mention: "UPSHOT is a 1–4 player co-op arena shooter. We grew up playing Bubble Trouble, and we always wondered what it would be like if our friends could play it with us.

articles.title: Building on open source AI? Hugging Face’s policy chief on the costs, risks, and trade-offs
articles.summary: On this episode of TechCrunch’s Equity podcast, Rebecca Bellan caught up with Irene Solaiman , Chief Policy Officer and SVP of Strategy at Hugging Face, about what startups need to know before building on open models, from choosing the right tools and infrastructure to navigating the trade-offs shaping the future of open AI.

articles.title: Apple disables Siri AI waitlist in iOS 27, with one exception
articles.summary: When Siri AI launched in iOS 27 earlier this fall, Apple used a waitlist to gate access. But a newly updated support document says the waitlist is no longer being used, except in “high demand” times.

articles.title: Classic ARPG Torchlight II returns with lots of improvements using AI assistance
articles.summary: The newer owners of the Torchlight IP (XD INC) have started reviving the classic action-RPG Torchlight II, with multiple Beta upgrades to test out. Read the full article on GamingOnLinux .

articles.title: New open-source benchmark reveals reasoning as the biggest bottleneck for AI in cloud operations
articles.summary: CloudOpsBench is a new open-source benchmark that measures how well AI agents handle typical DevOps tasks in the cloud, from fixing services and removing resources to restricting access rights, rolling out updates, and decommissioning projects.

articles.title: GPT-6 Astra sees the matrix and reprograms other AI models directly through their weights
articles.summary: MIT researchers show that GPT-6 Astra can directly understand and modify the internal settings of other AI models without traditional training. The approach has limits but could change how AI systems are tuned and controlled.

articles.title: iOS 27.3 upgrades Apple Music in two ways, here’s what’s new
articles.summary: If you’re an Apple Music subscriber , iOS 27.3 so far has two main changes to look forward to when it ships next month .

articles.title: CodeQL 2.27.4 improves accuracy and query metadata
articles.summary: CodeQL is the static analysis engine behind GitHub code scanning, which finds and remediates security issues in your code. We’ve recently released CodeQL 2.27.4 with query accuracy improvements across several languages, stronger security checks when you bundle or publish a pack, and corrections to query metadata.

articles.title: GitHub Copilot is now available in Xcode’s coding assistant
articles.summary: You can now work with GitHub Copilot directly in Xcode’s built-in coding assistant , bringing Copilot into your native Xcode workflow. The integration is now in public preview, available starting with Xcode 27.3 beta.

articles.title: macOS 27.3 Brings Live Activities to Macs Without Dynamic Island
articles.summary: The first macOS 27.3 developer beta released this week enables Live Activities support in the menu bar for several of Apple's built-in apps, along with things like screen recording.

articles.title: CodeQL 2.27.3 adds Python 3.15 features and JSON data extensions
articles.summary: CodeQL is the static analysis engine behind GitHub code scanning, which finds and remediates security issues in your code. We’ve recently released CodeQL 2.27.3 .

articles.title: Dependabot now supports Python 3.15
articles.summary: You can now upgrade your projects to Python 3.15 and keep receiving Dependabot updates. Support for Python 3.15 is available to all github.com users and will be included in GitHub Enterprise Server 3.24.
